## What it checks (sampled describe/it titles)

- SensorFusionEngine
- fuses multi-sensor data into state estimates
- produces covariance diagonal matching state dimension
- detects sensor dropout when data is missing
- reports all dropout when no data provided
- detects increasing force trend (tool wear)
